attributes.name: secondary action button style
attributes.definition: Visual treatment of secondary or auxiliary action buttons (e.g. Compare, Show all) on the page.

values.definition: Secondary buttons have a visible border with transparent or no fill.
Secondary buttons have a solid background fill.
Secondary actions appear as plain text or link style with no button chrome.
No secondary action buttons are shown.
Secondary buttons use some other treatment, or the treatment is not specified.

attributes.name: secondary action placement
attributes.definition: Where secondary action controls are positioned relative to the content they act on.

values.definition: Placed beneath the cards or list they relate to.
Placed above or in a header over the content.
Placed to the side of or inline with the content.
Placement is not stated or no such actions exist.

attributes.name: card accent border
attributes.definition: Presence and position of a coloured accent border on cards.

values.definition: Cards carry a coloured border or stripe on the left edge.
Cards carry a coloured border or stripe on the top edge.
Cards have a uniform border on all sides with no accent.
Cards have no border or accent.

attributes.name: list truncation control
attributes.definition: Whether long lists are truncated and how the user expands them.

values.definition: List is truncated, with a button that reveals the full list.
List is split into numbered or next/previous pages.
More items load automatically on scroll.
The full list is shown with no expansion control.
